sources.details: Projector: 8*16+8=136. One width-8 default block: two affine LayerNorms 2*(8+8)=32; four no-bias attention maps 4*(8*8)=256; FFN hidden=4*8=32, up=32*8+32=288, down=8*32+8=264; total block=32+256+288+264=840. sources.title: Independent two-step AdamW history and decay derivation
sources.details: For g1=1,g2=0,beta1=.9,beta2=.999,eta=.1,eps=1e-8: m1=.1,v1=.001; m2=.09,v2=.000999. Second normalized update=.1*(.09/(1-.9**2))/(sqrt(.000999/(1-.999**2))+1e-8)=.0670058244658113. With no decay it is subtracted from1.900000001 to give1.8329941765341886; with decay.2 multiply1.860000001 by.98 then subtract it, giving1.7557941765141885. None is not a numerical gradient and _init_group omits the entire update. Fresh g=0 and no state gives pure decay2*(1-.1*.2)=1.96, or2 with decay0. Original count derivation remains136/976.
